# Residual bias with linearised and exact weights, Qwen3-0.6B

Generated by `scripts/measure.py summarize residual-bias-exact` from the per-step records `<run>/step_<t>.json`. Cells: mean over seeds, per-seed values in brackets (seeds [0, 1, 2]). Both versions on the same regenerated 4a batch against the same b = g_corr - g_on and n = g_on' - g_on. lin: w = -A l (SC token), -A sum_{t'<t} l (prefix); exact: A (1 - e^{delta}) (SC token), -A max(e^{delta} - 2, 0) (TIS token), A (1 - e^{S_t}) (prefix), S_t = sum_{t'<t} delta; delta = l on stale64, log p_theta_t - log q on fp8_stale64.
